boundaryDefinitions.openWorldDistribution: A published library entry must keep its documented export names callable because future consumers are unknown. Internal identifiers and proven-private fields may still be mangled.
boundaryDefinitions.closedWorldApplication: The complete consumer graph is known. Tree shaking may remove unused public APIs, and every remaining binding may be renamed when no external string/reflection contract exposes it.

upstream.sourcePolicy: Pinned upstream test files are executed unchanged; public solid-js, solid-js/web, and solid-js/store entries resolve to SolidLil.

excludedTargets.c: LilScript native targets do not yet implement JavaScript exception and Promise semantics

surfaces.title: core browser API
surfaces.notes: Reusable open-world ESM preserves the Solid public ABI; the closed-world runtime mangles every exported binding.

surfaces.title: store browser API
surfaces.notes: Immutable and mutable stores, path updates, reconciliation, producer updates, tracking, and disposal are behavior-equivalent.

surfaces.title: client Web API
surfaces.scope: 46 client-rendering exports; SSR and hydration excluded
surfaces.notes: Client rendering, DOM mutation, events, control flow, portals, and teardown are behavior-equivalent. SSR and hydration are explicitly outside this target.

surfaces.title: full Web compatibility API
surfaces.scope: complete 73-export browser entry including compatibility stubs
surfaces.notes: The complete browser entry remains separately verified and measured; it is not the declared client-only implementation target.

lifecycle.definition: Solid and SolidLil execute identical ownership/disposal workloads; retained-heap eligibility is measured separately with repeated isolated samples.

lsx.definition: Complete client parity requires lowering and integrated differential runtime evidence for every in-scope client-rendering feature family. Hydration and SSR are separately inventoried and explicitly excluded because they require a coordinated server runtime.

runtimeEvidence.comparison: Both fixtures mount into independent Playwright Chromium contexts, execute the same mutations and real browser events, compare normalized DOM/state snapshots, verify keyed identity, then assert unmount cleanup.

features.label: Host elements and nesting
features.notes: Static host elements and nested elements compile from .lilx and mount through the LilScript DOM runtime.

features.label: Static attributes
features.notes: Quoted and boolean host attributes compile to DOM attribute calls and are asserted after mount.

features.label: Dynamic attributes
features.notes: Each dynamic host property receives an independent render effect so unrelated dependencies do not rerun.

features.label: Value and checked properties
features.notes: String and boolean property updates have dedicated host calls.

features.label: Reactive text expressions
features.notes: Expression children lower to owned text insertion.

features.label: Delegated events
features.notes: Common bubbling events lower through the delegated host path.

features.label: Native event listeners
features.notes: Non-delegated scroll event lowering compiles and updates reactive state in the integrated fixture.

features.label: classList updates
features.notes: Each object-shaped class flag receives an independent render effect and cleanup scope.

features.label: Show control flow
features.notes: Arbitrary truthy values, keyed raw-value callbacks, non-keyed live accessors, DOM identity, component/nested branches, fallback replacement, stale-accessor guards, ownership, and immediate cleanup are integrated.

features.label: For control flow
features.notes: Full LilScript callback types, host/component rows, live index accessors, component fallbacks, prefix/suffix duplicate identity, insertion, reordering, removal, fallback ownership, and row cleanup are integrated.

features.label: Index control flow
features.notes: Typed signal rows, positional identity, value updates, removal, and host fallback lowering are integrated.

features.label: Switch and Match
features.notes: Ordered short-circuit selection, arbitrary truthy values, keyed raw callbacks, non-keyed accessors, fallback, component/nested branches, stale-accessor guards, ownership, and cleanup are differential-tested.

features.label: User components
features.notes: User components have ordered live props, children, component spreads, nested control-flow composition, fragment normalization, keyed/indexed row use, and owned cleanup evidence.

features.label: Spread props
features.notes: Ordered component and host spreads support later overrides, live getters, properties, attributes, classList, style, refs, listener replacement, and unmount listener cleanup.

features.label: Refs
features.notes: Callback refs receive the created host node once during untracked construction.

features.label: use: directives
features.notes: use: directives lower through the owned untracked runtime helper with an explicit value.

features.label: Dynamic elements/components
features.notes: Dynamic lowers live string, component, and null selections with live props/children, SVG namespace selection, immediate branch cleanup, and identity pruning.

features.label: Portal
features.notes: Ordinary, document-head, SVG, and shadow-root portals lower with refs, reactive children, delegated event hosting, idempotent teardown, and handle release.

features.label: SVG and MathML namespaces
features.notes: Nested SVG and MathML nodes lower to namespace-aware constructors and are asserted by namespace URI.

features.label: Namespaced attributes
features.notes: Static and reactive xlink/xml names resolve to setAttributeNS and are asserted through namespace-aware DOM reads.

features.label: Hydration
features.notes: Out of scope for the client-rendering parity contract; true hydration requires a coordinated server marker, event replay, resource handoff, and mismatch-recovery subsystem.

features.label: SSR
features.notes: Out of scope for the client-rendering parity contract; no server template or streaming claim is made.

features.label: Suspense and error boundaries
features.notes: Typed ErrorBoundary fallbacks and reset callbacks, construction and delayed reactive errors, two-resource Suspense reveal, preserved pending content ownership, fallback/content cleanup, pending unmount, slot release, and minified-bundle behavior are differential-tested.

appSnapshot.notes: The historical todolist bytes remain useful LSX context, but they predate the canonical scorer and are excluded from current size, behavior, and performance evidence.
